result.topic_en: Gauss transforms the differential equation satisfied by the reciprocal of the arithmetic-geometric mean via x = cos φ, states its particular and complete integrals in terms of M(1, cos φ) and M(1, sin φ), and tries series and coefficient-table methods for its solution.

methods.what: Differential equation satisfied by the reciprocal AGM as a function of x
Change of variable x = cos φ
Particular and general solution in terms of the arithmetic-geometric mean
Trial Laurent-type series ansatz in t and its derivatives
Recursive expressions for higher derivatives of P(φ)=1/M(1,cos φ)
Coefficient comparison tables giving relations among series coefficients
Power series expansion of 1/M in s and in φ
